summary: Round-1 verification noted that the Paid lock set was not asserted directly: `PaymentMethod` and `PaidDate` were shown unlocked in `Shipped`, but not explicitly shown locked in `Paid`.
fix: Added `LockedFieldsFor_PaidOrderLocksPaymentFieldsButNotNotes` to pin that `PaymentMethod` and `PaidDate` lock at `Paid` while `Notes` remains editable until `Closed`.
